title: Slow German
author: Annik Rubens
description: In this podcast, German podcaster Annik Rubens talks slowly about topics of everyday German life, from beergardens to recycling. More information and Premium Podcast with learning materials on Slow German at www.slowgerman.com. You can read the complete transcript of each episode on this internet-site or in the ID3-Tags.

extraits.texte: This is the best “slow German “ podcast I have encountered… and I have tried many… it is crafted in a way that you have a good balance between easy words and more challenging ones. Annik’s voice is pleasant and clear.…
